scenes.setting: 6 Edward Street, a human slaughterhouse: bodies in the cement, the walls and the weeds, from a decade old to the servants killed days ago; the owner is banker Patrick Jason — assets already liquidated, a failed devil summoning in a secret chamber, and a true name: Jason Beria, of the ancient Devil family
scenes.text_anchor: “Deacon, this place is like a human slaughterhouse!”

scenes.setting: Outside the villa, the wrongness named: a Coldblooded does not burn his whole life down for a dead dog, so revenge cannot be the whole motive; the three split to work their own channels — and Klein's first stop is the police station, to get his fifty pounds of bail back
